english.note: Use this natural Cantonese construction when something is present inside a mind or other space, rather than saying it is lived in.

examples.english: Lots of new ideas inhabit my mind.
examples.traditional: 我個腦入面有好多新諗法。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 nou5 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 nam2 faat3
